items.excerpt: Harvard researchers report that nearly 20% of young people in the US now use AI for mental health advice, a 60% jump in chatbot use among adolescents in a single year, with more than a third of psychologists seeing patients bring AI into therapy.

A West Virginia University study in npj Digital Medicine found ChatGPT-5 Pro can generate realistic psychiatry training vignettes with strong diagnostic detail, but safety checks showed human oversight remains essential.
A cognitive-science-inspired AI framework built on cognitive maps solves planning problems more efficiently and with far lower energy use than conventional deep neural networks.

Cleveland Clinic and IBM researchers built Q-CHIPP, a quantum machine learning framework that beats classical methods at predicting which tumor mutations trigger an immune response under data-limited conditions.

Northwestern, University of Chicago and Fermilab researchers deployed the first AI system that decides where a telescope points, scheduling Dark Energy Camera observations on the Blanco 4-meter telescope and adapting in real time to weather and seeing.

The US National Science Foundation is putting $380 million into AI-enabled autonomous laboratories, including a $20 million NC State-led 'self-driving' chemistry lab aimed at cutting molecular discovery from years to weeks.
OpenAI publicized 10 AI-generated mathematical results, but mathematicians say the write-ups failed to cite preexisting literature — amounting, experts argue, to research misconduct.
Science YouTuber Hank Green admitted leaning heavily on ChatGPT for video research and called the habit 'not healthy,' triggering a fan backlash and a wider debate about AI in science communication.
Ai2's TutorMoments is a replay-based evaluation built from real one-on-one math tutoring sessions, testing whether LLMs know when to help a student and when to hold back.
Schrödinger CEO Ramy Farid, a longtime physics-based-simulation partisan in drug design, explains what changed his mind about where machine learning now fits in computational discovery.
